stem: Which statement best explains the organizational pattern used in the article?

options.label: A
options.text: The similarities and differences between sports from the past and newer sports from today are explained.

options.label: B
options.text: The chronological order of events is used to describe how a particular sport developed over many years.

options.label: C
options.text: The advantages of leagues are presented to show how modern sports have improved on past disadvantages.

options.label: D
options.text: The classification of the features of modern sports emphasizes the influence society has had on sports.
